# rag-eval

> Evaluate a RAG system offline from golden and results JSONL files with recall, precision, MRR, nDCG and SQuAD-style answer metrics, and gate CI on thresholds Python package `trysac-rag-eval`, import name `rag_eval`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
